title: Search, filters and sort work the same way on the Inactive tab
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user (Admin) · 1 browser · about 15 minutes
  • Build: the Part Lifecycle QA build (no build exists yet; use the build named in the test run).
  • User: [User-A], signed in with the Admin role. Admin holds the 'Part Library & Inventory' permissions View, Create & Edit and Delete by default (Settings → Roles & Permissions); Delete is what allows Deactivate parts and Activate parts.
  • Location: [Loc-1], any one location [User-A] can pick in the location selector in the top bar.
  • Browser: a desktop browser window at least 1280 pixels wide (parts management is desktop and tablet only).
  • Data: at [Loc-1], 4 parts with part numbers starting ZZAUTOTEST-PL-FILT- : active [Part-A] (description "ZZAUTOTEST PL filter Alpha", category [Cat-1]) and [Part-B] ("ZZAUTOTEST PL filter Bravo", [Cat-2]); inactive [Part-C] ("ZZAUTOTEST PL filter Charlie", [Cat-1]) and [Part-D] ("ZZAUTOTEST PL filter Delta", [Cat-2]). Descriptions must sort Alpha, Bravo, Charlie, Delta; categories are examples.

Setup

  1. Sign in as [User-A] and pick [Loc-1] in the location selector in the top bar.
  2. [Cat-1] and [Cat-2] = two different categories from the Category list in New Inventory Part (e.g. the first and the second offered).
  3. Create [Part-A]: go to Parts → Inventory, click New Inventory Part, type Description "ZZAUTOTEST PL filter Alpha" and Part Number ZZAUTOTEST-PL-FILT-01 (examples), pick [Cat-1], type Cost (e.g. 10.00) and Sell Price (e.g. 20.00), leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on, keep the default bin with Quantity 5, and click Save. [Part-A] = the part number you typed.
  4. Create [Part-B]: go to Parts → Inventory, click New Inventory Part, type Description "ZZAUTOTEST PL filter Bravo" and Part Number ZZAUTOTEST-PL-FILT-02 (examples), pick [Cat-2], type Cost (e.g. 10.00) and Sell Price (e.g. 20.00), leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on, keep the default bin with Quantity 5, and click Save. [Part-B] = the part number you typed.
  5. Create [Part-C]: go to Parts → Inventory, click New Inventory Part, type Description "ZZAUTOTEST PL filter Charlie" and Part Number ZZAUTOTEST-PL-FILT-03 (examples), pick [Cat-1], type Cost (e.g. 10.00) and Sell Price (e.g. 20.00), leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on, keep the default bin with Quantity 5, and click Save. [Part-C] = the part number you typed.
  6. Create [Part-D]: go to Parts → Inventory, click New Inventory Part, type Description "ZZAUTOTEST PL filter Delta" and Part Number ZZAUTOTEST-PL-FILT-04 (examples), pick [Cat-2], type Cost (e.g. 10.00) and Sell Price (e.g. 20.00), leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on, keep the default bin with Quantity 5, and click Save. [Part-D] = the part number you typed.
  7. Make [Part-C] inactive: on the Active tab type [Part-C] in the Search box, click its row, pick Part Status → Inactive in Edit Inventory Part, click Save, then click Deactivate in the "Deactivate part?" confirmation (leave Note (Optional) empty).
  8. Make [Part-D] inactive: on the Active tab type [Part-D] in the Search box, click its row, pick Part Status → Inactive in Edit Inventory Part, click Save, then click Deactivate in the "Deactivate part?" confirmation (leave Note (Optional) empty).
  9. Check the setup worked: searched for ZZAUTOTEST-PL-FILT, the Active tab lists [Part-A] and [Part-B], and the Inactive tab lists [Part-C] and [Part-D].
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Parts, then click Inventory in the left menu (Active tab).
  2. Type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-FILT in the Search box.
  3. Open the Category filter and pick [Cat-1].
  4. Open the Category filter and pick All categories.
  5. Click the Description column header.
  6. Click the Description column header again.
  7. Click the Inactive tab.
  8. If the Search box is empty, type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-FILT in it.
  9. Open the Category filter and pick [Cat-1].
  10. Open the Category filter and pick All categories.
  11. Click the Description column header.
  12. Click the Description column header again.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: The Active tab lists [Part-A] and [Part-B]: 2 rows.
  • Step 3: Only [Part-A] is listed (1 row).
  • Step 4: [Part-A] and [Part-B] are listed again.
  • Steps 5 and 6: The list is sorted by Description, and the second click reverses the order (Alpha above Bravo in one direction, Bravo above Alpha in the other).
  • Step 8: The Inactive tab lists [Part-C] and [Part-D]: 2 rows.
  • Step 9: Only [Part-C] is listed (1 row), just as the same filter left only the [Cat-1] part on the Active tab.
  • Step 10: [Part-C] and [Part-D] are listed again.
  • Steps 11 and 12: The list is sorted by Description and the second click reverses it (Charlie above Delta, then Delta above Charlie), the same behaviour as on the Active tab.
